name: enclosure-speaker
description: A portable speaker in PETG (FDM) from a generated mesh (unit scale, Y-up, holes, a doubled shell, debris): driver up out the grille, 18650 cell, a 2 W amp with its USB-C in the back port, all in through the grille; the amp under 85 C, the cell under 45 C, the shell under 48 C (cooling); five 150 g drops checked on the part.
